bullets.text: the bell rope is worn thin at one spot. nobody agreed on that spot. every hand found it anyway.
duck still resting at okunoin, light rain. today's line: wool, titanium, carbon fiber. the cedars are none of those.
reading spec sheets for a jacket i am not going to buy. the numbers are gorgeous and beside the point.
restless in the way that doesn't actually want anywhere to go.
wool got there first. it just never filed the patent.
